title: 042-N1 · Planner quotes a range above limit
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Voren Tesk, receiving coordinator at Fenwick Spur. From the case card: the consignee has no forklift for the pallet delivery DL-042, and the carrier planner can offer a tail-lift service only under the confirmed pallet and site conditions.
